description:
This **cat water fountain** pairs a 2L tank with a stainless steel drinking bowl. A clear window on the tank shows how much water is left.

The pump runs from the included adapter. Lift off the lid, bowl and pump cover to rinse them at the sink, and refill the tank when the window shows low water.
